en.topic_title: Gov’t to revamp 1823 hotline, pledging 10-day response time for public enquiries
en.topic_summary:
Hong Kong’s government has announced new improvements to its 1823 hotline, pledging to respond to public enquiries and complaints within 10 days and to coordinate responses across various departments. 



Home page of the 1823 Call Centre. Photo: GovHK.



Deputy Chief Secretary Warner Cheuk said on RTHK on Tuesday that authorities were concerned about the problem of different departments passing the buck when a public complaint involved more than one part of government.
